Source repository: https://github.com/google/mozc
Source commit: 0136c35782536cb43d710575c311cd4185982738
Source files:
  src/data/symbol/symbol.tsv
  src/data/preedit/romanji-hiragana.tsv

Sumibi modifications:
  Extract readings and symbols; invert the romaji table to add kana/romaji
  lookup aliases; sort lookup keys; deduplicate symbols while preserving
  upstream row order. The resulting index is MozcSymbols.tsv.

Sumibi uses only these symbol/preedit data files, not Mozc's general-word
dictionary. The original repository LICENSE is included without changes;
its separate sections for src/data/dictionary* do not describe these files.

The generated Mozc-derived data is not relicensed as Sumibi's MIT code.
Neither Google nor Mozc's contributors endorse Sumibi.
